display_note: Owner's bike with SRAM RED AXS and Zipp 454 wheels, not the Force AXS and Zipp 303 S reference build. Signature watermark cropped.

review_evidence.conclusion: Original pixels reviewed: ROBIN EVO on the chainstay, a SRAM AXS rear derailleur and sawtooth Zipp rims. The post's cover photo of the same bike shows a SRAM RED crank and ZIPP 454 NSW rims, and the text calls the 454 wheels original equipment, so this is not the Force AXS and Zipp 303 S reference trim. The post does not state the generation; its hidden routing and integrated cockpit match the third-generation platform. The right edge was cropped to remove the photographer's signature; no bike pixels were removed.
